question: The central board of the Reserve Bank of India can have a maximum of ________ full time Deputy Governors at any given time.
solution:
The correct answer is **__4__.**

• The RBI has 4 deputy governor - 2 are appointed from outside while the remaining 2 are promoted from within. The other 2 appointed from outside, one is commercial banker and the other is economist.
